settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: Switches the app's own text only — generated contracts, change orders, and other documents always stay in English.

projects.title: Customers & Projects
projects.emptyState: No projects yet. Start one from a QuickBooks estimate.

projects.editDriveFolderTitle: Set or correct the Drive folder for this project
projects.dateEditTitle: Set or correct the project's start/end dates — required for the Analytics page's Timeline and Concurrency charts
projects.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? This removes its estimate, scope & payment schedule, contract package, and change orders. Receipts and bank transactions become unassigned instead of being deleted. Its Google Drive folder is NOT deleted and becomes available again under Import from Drive. This can't be undone.

estimateUpload.title: Estimate Upload
estimateUpload.context: Start a new project from a QuickBooks estimate
estimateUpload.qbNotConnected: not connected — fetches use demo data (1042, 2091)
estimateUpload.qbConnectedBanner: QuickBooks connected. Estimate fetches now hit your real company data.
estimateUpload.qbDisconnectedBanner: QuickBooks was disconnected from the QuickBooks side (Manage Apps). Reconnect here whenever you're ready.
estimateUpload.qbErrorBanner: QuickBooks connection failed{{reason}}. Check the client ID/secret and redirect URI in app/backend/.env, then try again.
estimateUpload.googleNotConnected: not connected — Drive folders/Sheets use fake IDs
estimateUpload.googleConnectedBanner: Google Workspace connected. New projects now get a real Drive folder and reconciliation Sheet.
estimateUpload.googleErrorBanner: Google connection failed{{reason}}. Check the client ID/secret and redirect URI in app/backend/.env, then try again.
estimateUpload.importFromDriveNotePrefix: Importing a project that already existed in Drive before this app? That's a separate flow — see
estimateUpload.step1Title: Step 1 — Get the estimate from QuickBooks

estimateUpload.notFoundMessage: No estimate found for "{{number}}". Try 1042 or 2091, or upload the PDF below.
estimateUpload.orNoEstimateNumber: Or, if there is no estimate number
estimateUpload.uploadPrompt: Upload the estimate, or a contractor's job notes
estimateUpload.pasteHelperText: Useful when a .docx or .xlsx won't read correctly (it may not actually be a valid Office file) — copy its text and paste it here instead.
estimateUpload.pastePlaceholder: Paste the estimate or job notes text here…
estimateUpload.paymentScheduleHelp: This will pre-fill the Project Scope & Payment Schedule step instead of its usual deposit/final-payment default.

estimateUpload.addPhaseNotesButton: Add Notes to Fill In or Correct the Payment Schedule
estimateUpload.combineNotesHelp: Paste notes that mention phases, payment amounts, or other details the estimate above is missing — they're combined with what's already here, not used to replace it. Phase numbers are reassigned in order automatically.
